# rypipe Documentation

> Format-agnostic columnar ingestion engine. Rust core, Python bindings, parallel scheduling, memory-bounded execution, and Arrow export.

## Overview
- [rypipe](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/): Format-agnostic columnar engine that turns byte streams into Arrow record batches

## Tutorial
- [Tutorial index](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/): Install rypipe + an adapter, read your first file
- [First Steps](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/first-steps/): Create a Source, get a DataFrame, chain your first stage
- [Pipeline](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/pipeline/): Chain stages with the | operator; plans and fusion
- [Stages](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/stages/): CastTypes, FilterRows, RenameFields, DropFields, combinators
- [Sinks](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/sinks/): to_arrow, to_pandas, to_polars, to_parquet, collect, to_csv
- [Streaming](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/streaming/): iter_record_batches with bounded memory
- [Configuration](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/configuration/): rypipe.read() options and Source constructor options

## Building an Adapter
- [Building an Adapter overview](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/): The crxml formula; Source, Adapter, stages, registration
- [Walkthrough](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/walkthrough/): Build a complete working adapter, step by step
- [Python Wiring](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/python-wiring/): Source subclass, adapter class, registration, re-exported stages and sinks, kwargs, engine selection, streaming
- [Rust Creation](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/rust-creation/): Splitter, RecordParser, ColumnarSink implementation guide
- [Schema](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/schema/): Schema declaration for maximum performance
- [Techniques](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/techniques/): Performance optimizations for production adapters
- [Anti-patterns](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/anti-patterns/): Common mistakes to avoid
- [Splitter](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/splitter/): The Splitter trait; finding row boundaries
- [Parser](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/parser/): The RecordParser trait; extracting field values
- [Sink](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/sink/): The ColumnarSink trait; accumulating typed columns
- [Scan primitives](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/scan/): Portable byte-search primitives
- [Skip regions](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/skip-regions/): Marking regions to skip during parsing
- [Chunk planning](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/chunk-planning/): Estimating rows per chunk for balanced parallelism
- [Examples](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/building-adapters/examples/): Worked CSV, JSONL, and TSV adapters

## Advanced
- [Advanced overview](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/): Roadmap and checklist for the advanced section
- [Pushdown fusion](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/fusion/): How stages collapse into an ExecutionPlan
- [Stage protocol](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/stage-protocol/): The stage protocol, why re-exporting works, when to re-implement
- [Execution modes](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/execution-modes/): Stream, columnar, parallel, and auto engine selection
- [Memory and chunking](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/memory-and-chunking/): Memory budgets and chunk sizing
- [Parallelism](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/parallelism/): rayon internals and measuring speedup
- [Dictionary encoding](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/dictionary-encoding/): Arrow dictionaries and auto_dict
- [Schema and types](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/schema-and-types/): schema_order, field_types, and numeric compare filters
- [I/O tuning](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/io-tuning/): mmap vs buffered reads and storage classes
- [Adapter design](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/adapter-design/): Splitter, RecordParser, memchr, and sink.wants
- [Adapter design patterns](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/source-pattern/): Common adapter patterns and when to use them
- [Profiling](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/profiling/): perf, flamegraph, and RSS measurement
- [Anti-patterns](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/anti-patterns/): Common mistakes that hurt throughput and memory
- [Case study: crxml](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/case-study-crxml/): How crxml reaches multi-GB/s throughput
- [Streaming with constant memory](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/advanced/streaming/): Streaming execution with bounded memory

## Architecture
- [Architecture Overview](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/): Splitting, row extraction, typed builders, and engine design
- [Engine](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/engine/): TableBuilder; row handling, dirty tracking, column dispatch
- [Columnar storage](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/columnar/): StrColumn, ColumnBuilder variants, dictionary, promotions
- [Execution plan](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/plan/): ExecutionPlan, FieldType, FilterPredicate trees
- [Decoder API](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/decoder/): Splitter, RecordParser, ColumnarSink traits
- [Execution](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/execution/): Pipeline, Parallel, Bounded, InputBuffer
- [Data flow](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/data-flow/): Diagrams for single, parallel, bounded modes
- [Storage and export](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/storage/): Arrow export, null handling, compare filter
- [Schema](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/schema/): FrozenSchema, DiscoveryOpts, layout_signature caching
- [Optimizations](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/optimizations/): Every optimization and why it matters
- [Lambda compiler](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/architecture/lambda-compiler/): Compiling Python lambdas to native filters

## Reference
- [Python API](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/reference/python-api/): rypipe.read, Source, Adapter, Pipeline, stages, sinks, exceptions
- [Rust API](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/reference/rust-api/): Splitter, RecordParser, ColumnarSink, ExecutionPlan, Pipeline, Value

## Examples
- [Examples](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/examples/): Python and Rust API recipes for reading, pipelines, adapters, and sinks
- [crxml adapter](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/crxml-adapter/): Real-world adapter example; Crystal Reports XML parser built on rypipe-core

## Internals
- [Performance](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/performance/): Parallel scheduling, memory budgets, and optimization notes
- [Why Python?](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/why-python/): Why rypipe uses Python bindings instead of pure Rust
- [Contributing](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/contributing/): How to contribute to rypipe

For the full documentation in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](https://rypipe.emiliano-go.com/llms-full.txt).
